changeSet.author: tradeflow-team
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE trades ( id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY, trade_ref varchar(100) UNIQUE NOT NULL, instrument_id BIGINT NOT NULL, counterparty_id BIGINT NOT NULL, quantity NUMERIC(18,4) NOT NULL, price NUMERIC(18,4) NOT NULL, trade_date DATE NOT NULL, status VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL default 'PENDING', )
